title: Is Riftn Legit? Company, Audits, Token and Track Record Since 2021
html:
Before you sign up for a new app, especially one with a token, you should ask whether it is real. Here is everything about Riftn that you can check for yourself, including the parts that went wrong.

The short answer: yes. Riftn has run since 2021, first as FTV and then as DeHub. Its co-founders are named, its web app's code is public on GitHub, its token contract was audited by CertiK, and its apps are live on the web and Google Play. The new $RIFT token is not trading yet, so anyone selling it today is a scammer.

What Riftn is

Riftn is a social media protocol. Its own apps run video, shorts, live streams, music, encrypted messages, communities, games and a built-in wallet on top of it. You sign in with Google, Apple, email or phone, and Riftn creates your wallet for you. You do not need crypto to use it.

Who runs it

Riftn has four named co-founders, listed with their backgrounds on the team page:

  • Mal Jan: full stack web and blockchain developer.
  • Mike Hales: founder of the Rapz fightwear brand and co-founder of the TikTok partner agency First Class.
  • Indi Jay Cammish: communications and corporate relations, also a co-founder of First Class.
  • Bailey Young: operations, investments and tokenomics.

The project launched in 2021 as FTV, became DeHub, and in November 2026 became Riftn. Same team, new name.

What you can verify yourself

  • The code. Riftn's web app is open source. Anyone can read it, and every change, on the Riftn GitHub.
  • The audit. CertiK audited the token contract. The report sits on CertiK Skynet, linked from the security page.
  • The press. US Weekly, Yahoo Finance, Entrepreneur and Investing.com have covered the project. Links are on the featured-in page.
  • The apps. Riftn runs in any browser at riftn.com and is on Google Play.
  • The contact points. Support answers at dev@riftn.com and in the official Telegram.

The token, honestly

Riftn uses a utility token, $RIFT, for tips, unlocks, rewards and AI credits. The new $RIFT token is not trading yet. It has no contract address and no exchange listing. When it launches, Riftn will announce it in the app and on the where-to-buy page.

Two things follow from that:

  • Anyone selling $RIFT today, or posting a "Riftn contract address", is a scammer.
  • A different coin, Rift AI, uses a similar ticker. It has nothing to do with Riftn.

Riftn's docs call the token a utility, not an investment, and say plainly that crypto markets are volatile and you should only spend what you can afford to lose.

What went wrong, and what was said about it

In 2021, DeHub hired a listing agent for a Gate.io launch. The agent took the money raised and sold the tokens instead of distributing them to Gate users. Riftn published the full story rather than hiding it: read what happened.

How to stay safe on any crypto app

  • Ignore direct messages that ask for money. Treat any DM that asks for a payment, a seed phrase or a login code as a scam, whoever it claims to be from.
  • Check links by hand. The official site is riftn.com.
  • Trust announcements, not screenshots. A real token launch appears in the app and in the docs, not in a stranger's message.
  • Never share a seed phrase or a one-time code with anyone, for any reason.

Frequently asked questions

Is Riftn safe to use?

Yes. You sign in with Google, Apple, email or phone, no crypto needed. As with any app, never share your login codes.

Is Riftn a scam?

No. It has named founders, public code, an audited contract and a track record since 2021. Scammers do use its name, so only trust riftn.com and the official channels.

Is Riftn the same as DeHub?

Yes. DeHub became Riftn in November 2026. Same team, same project, new name. Read the full story.

Can I buy the Riftn token?

Not yet. The new $RIFT token is not trading. Join the launch list to hear first.

Who owns Riftn?

Its co-founders run it, and the token is designed so that users share in protocol revenue. See the team page for names.

Riftn is a social media protocol you can check line by line. Look around for yourself.
